name: Rootha, Mastering the Moment
oracle_text: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you've cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, create an X/X blue and red Elemental creature token with flying and haste, where X is the greatest mana value among instant and sorcery spells you've cast this turn.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you've cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn, create an X/X blue and red Elemental creature token with flying and haste, where X is the greatest mana value among instant and sorcery spells you've cast this turn.

needs.what: a value reading the greatest printed mana value among the spells a player cast this turn that match a filter (here instant and sorcery spells you've cast), read off TurnLedger.spells_cast_ids like spells_cast_this_turn's filter form; e.g. extreme_value accepting a spells_cast_this_turn source in place of objects
needs.why_existing_wont_do: spells_cast_this_turn with a filter only counts the matching spells, and extreme_value only resolves an `objects` pool of objects in zones -- resolved instants and sorceries have left the stack, so neither yields their greatest mana value

needs.what: an X/X blue and red Elemental creature token with flying and haste (power/toughness set by create_token's power/toughness)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has elemental_3_3_ur_flying (no haste), elemental_1_1_ur and elemental_4_4_ur (no flying/haste) and dragon_illusion_x_x_r_flying_haste (wrong colour and types); none is a blue-red Elemental with flying and haste
